test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 19 April 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.**

__Such was__ his performance that the audience gave a standing ovation.
solution:
The correct answer is **"No substitution required"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given sentence, "No substitution required" is the correct answer.
 
• According to grammar, "such" is used before a noun or noun phrase to add emphasis.
 
• In the given sentence, "such" acts as a noun.
 
• Let's see an example-
 
 
• Such cruelty really is beyond my comprehension.
 
 

**So the correct sentence is- *****Such was **his performance that the audience gave a standing ovation.*
